title: Cam Skattebo renews backflip celebration days after vowing to shelve it: 'It's hard to hold back from'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cam Skattebo renews backflip celebration days after vowing to shelve it: 'It's hard to hold back from'
sources.description: Skattebo vowed in the aftermath of Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending celebration injury that he was done doing backflips. That promise lasted less than four quarters.
